<script>
     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            return link

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            return link

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                count--

                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                }

            document.head.append(fragment)

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }

            document.head.append(fragment)

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {

                count--

                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            return link

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                count--

                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)

            if (count > assets.length) {

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)

            return link

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

            })

            return link

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

                count--

            document.head.append(fragment)

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                count--

                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }

            document.head.append(fragment)

            })

            return link

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                count--

                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {

                }

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {

                count--

                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

                }

                count--

                }

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

    }))

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

            const link = document.createElement('link')

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

  {
    let elements = document.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')
    for (let element of elements) {
      let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
      element.addEventListener(
        'focus',
        (e) => {
          element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
          element.value = value
          element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
        },
        { once: true },
      )
    }
  }
</script>

                }

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

  {
    let elements = document.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')
    for (let element of elements) {
      let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
      element.addEventListener(
        'focus',
        (e) => {
          element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
          element.value = value
          element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
        },
        { once: true },
      )
    }
  }
</script>

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

  {
    let elements = document.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')
    for (let element of elements) {
      let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
      element.addEventListener(
        'focus',
        (e) => {
          element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
          element.value = value
          element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
        },
        { once: true },
      )
    }
  }
</script>

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

  {
    let elements = document.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')
    for (let element of elements) {
      let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
      element.addEventListener(
        'focus',
        (e) => {
          element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
          element.value = value
          element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
        },
        { once: true },
      )
    }
  }
</script>

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

  {
    let elements = document.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')

<script>
  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

  {
    let elements = document.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')
    for (let element of elements) {
      let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
      element.addEventListener(
        'focus',
        (e) => {
          element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
          element.value = value
          element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
        },
        { once: true },
      )
    }
  }
</script>

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

  {
    let elements = document.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')
    for (let element of elements) {
      let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
      element.addEventListener(
        'focus',
        (e) => {
          element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
          element.value = value
          element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
        },
        { once: true },
      )
    }
  }
</script>

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
