      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {

                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

  {
    let elements = document.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')
    for (let element of elements) {
      let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
      element.addEventListener(
        'focus',
        (e) => {
          element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
          element.value = value
          element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
        },
        { once: true },
      )
    }
  }

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

  {
    let elements = document.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')
    for (let element of elements) {
      let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
      element.addEventListener(
        'focus',
        (e) => {
          element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
          element.value = value
          element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
        },
        { once: true },
      )
    }
  }
</script>

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())

                count--

                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

  {
    let elements = document.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')
    for (let element of elements) {
      let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
      element.addEventListener(
        'focus',
        (e) => {
          element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
          element.value = value
          element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
        },
        { once: true },
      )
    }
  }

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      let command = document.getElementById('command')

      command.querySelector('input').addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        let value = event.target.value
        if (value === '?') {
          command.dataset.mode = 'help'
        } else if (value.startsWith('#')) {
          command.dataset.mode = 'project'
        } else if (value.startsWith('>')) {
          command.dataset.mode = 'user'
        } else {
          delete command.dataset.mode
        }
      })

      command.setFilterCallback(({ query, node, content }) => {
        if (query === '?') {
          return false
        }
        if (query.startsWith('#')) {
          return node.dataset.type === 'project' && content.toLowerCase().includes(query.slice(1).toLowerCase())
        }
        if (query.startsWith('>')) {
          return node.dataset.type === 'user' && content.toLowerCase().includes(query.slice(1).toLowerCase())
        }
        return content.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())
      })
    }

    if (customElements.get('el-command')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

  <script type="module">
    function onReady() {
      let command = document.getElementById('command')

      command.querySelector('input').addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        let value = event.target.value
        if (value === '?') {
          command.dataset.mode = 'help'
        } else if (value.startsWith('#')) {
          command.dataset.mode = 'project'
        } else if (value.startsWith('>')) {
          command.dataset.mode = 'user'
        } else {
          delete command.dataset.mode
        }
      })

      command.setFilterCallback(({ query, node, content }) => {
        if (query === '?') {
          return false
        }
        if (query.startsWith('#')) {
          return node.dataset.type === 'project' && content.toLowerCase().includes(query.slice(1).toLowerCase())
        }
        if (query.startsWith('>')) {
          return node.dataset.type === 'user' && content.toLowerCase().includes(query.slice(1).toLowerCase())
        }
        return content.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())
      })
    }

    if (customElements.get('el-command')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

  <script type="module">
    function onReady() {
      let command = document.getElementById('command')

      command.querySelector('input').addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        let value = event.target.value
        if (value === '?') {
          command.dataset.mode = 'help'
        } else if (value.startsWith('#')) {
          command.dataset.mode = 'project'
        } else if (value.startsWith('>')) {
          command.dataset.mode = 'user'
        } else {
          delete command.dataset.mode
        }
      })

      command.setFilterCallback(({ query, node, content }) => {
        if (query === '?') {
          return false
        }
        if (query.startsWith('#')) {
          return node.dataset.type === 'project' && content.toLowerCase().includes(query.slice(1).toLowerCase())
        }
        if (query.startsWith('>')) {
          return node.dataset.type === 'user' && content.toLowerCase().includes(query.slice(1).toLowerCase())
        }
        return content.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())
      })
    }

    if (customElements.get('el-command')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

<script>
     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

<script>
     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {

                }

            document.head.append(fragment)

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {

                count--

            document.head.append(fragment)

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

                }

            document.head.append(fragment)

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

            return link

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }

          'beforetoggle',

            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value

            }

            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }

            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

                    return

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

            return link

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {

                count--

                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

            if (count > assets.length) {

                count--

                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))
