<script>
  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            return link

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {

                }

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

  {
    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

                count--

                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                    return

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

<script>
     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {

        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            return link

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            return link

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            return link

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }

            document.head.append(fragment)

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }

            document.head.append(fragment)

          <div>

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {

            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {

                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                count--

                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

            return link

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {

                }

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

At the beginning at least, but then we realized we could make a lot more money if we kinda stopped caring about that. Our new strategy is to write a bunch of things that look really good in the headlines, then clarify in the small print but hope people don't actually read it.

Free shipping

It's not actually free we just price it into the products. Someone's paying for it, and it's not us.

10-year warranty

If it breaks in the first 10 years we'll replace it. After that you're on your own though.

Exchanges

If you don't like it, trade it to one of your friends for something of theirs. Don't send it here though.

Drawstring Canister

Use it your way

The Drawstring Canister comes with multiple strap and handle options to adapt throughout your day. Shoulder sling it, backpack it, or handy carry it.

Adventure-ready

The Drawstring Canister is water and tear resistant with durable canvas construction. This bag holds up to the demands of daily use while keeping your snacks secure.

Minimal and clean

Everything you need, nothing you don't. This bag has the simple, contemporary design that enables you to tell everyone you know about how essentialism is the only rational way to live life.

Organized

Never lose your snacks again with our patent-pending snack stash pocket system. With dedicated pouches for each of your snacking needs, the Drawstring Canister unlocks new levels of efficiency and convenience.

html.code:
Technical Specifications

The Organize modular system offers endless options for arranging your favorite and most used items. Keep everything at reach and in its place, while dressing up your workspace.

Adaptive and modular

The Organize base set allows you to configure and evolve your setup as your items and habits change. The included trays and optional add-ons are easily rearranged to achieve that perfect setup.

Natural wood options

Organize has options for rich walnut and bright maple base materials. Accent your desk with a contrasting material, or match similar woods for a calm and cohesive look. Every base is hand sanded and finished.

Helpful around the home

Our customers use Organize throughout the house to bring efficiency to many daily routines. Enjoy Organize in your workspace, kitchen, living room, entry way, garage, and more. We can't wait to see how you'll use it!

Everything you'll need

The Organize base set includes the pen, phone, small, and large trays to help you group all your essential items. Expand your set with the drink coaster and headphone stand add-ons.

Application UI Icon Pack

Product information

Version 1.0 (Updated June 5, 2021)

Reviews

4 out of 5 stars

The Application UI Icon Pack comes with over 200 icons in 3 styles: outline, filled, and branded. This playful icon pack is tailored for complex application user interfaces with a friendly and legible look.

Highlights

  • 200+ SVG icons in 3 unique styles
  • Compatible with Figma, Sketch, and Adobe XD
  • Drawn on 24 x 24 pixel grid

License

For personal and professional use. You cannot resell or redistribute these icons in their original or modified state. Read full license

Share

  • Share on Facebook
  • Share on Instagram
  • Share on X

Customer Reviews

Emily Selman

July 16, 2021

5 out of 5 stars

This icon pack is just what I need for my latest project. There's an icon for just about anything I could ever need. Love the playful look!

Hector Gibbons

July 12, 2021

5 out of 5 stars

Blown away by how polished this icon pack is. Everything looks so consistent and each SVG is optimized out of the box so I can use it directly with confidence. It would take me several hours to create a single icon this good, so it's a steal at this price.

Mark Edwards

July 6, 2021

4 out of 5 stars

Really happy with look and options of these icons. I've found uses for them everywhere in my recent projects. I hope there will be 20px versions in the future!

Frequently Asked Questions

What format are these icons?

The icons are in SVG (Scalable Vector Graphic) format. They can be imported into your design tool of choice and used directly in code.

Can I use the icons at different sizes?

Yes. The icons are drawn on a 24 x 24 pixel grid, but the icons can be scaled to different sizes as needed. We don't recommend going smaller than 20 x 20 or larger than 64 x 64 to retain legibility and visual balance.

Do I have to add attribution to my projects?

No. You are allowed to use these icons freely in your personal and professional work. If you enjoy the icon pack, feel free to tell others!

License

Overview

For personal and professional use. You cannot resell or redistribute these icons in their original or modified state.

  • You're allowed to use the icons in unlimited projects.
  • Attribution is not required to use the icons.

What you can do with it

  • Use them freely in your personal and professional work.
  • Make them your own. Change the colors to suit your project or brand.

What you can't do with it

  • Don't be greedy. Selling or distributing these icons in their original or modified state is prohibited.
  • Don't be evil. These icons cannot be used on websites or applications that promote illegal or immoral beliefs or activities.

        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {

<script>
     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }

        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }

        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

    function onReady() {
      for (let elDialog of document.querySelectorAll('el-dialog')) {
        let dialog = elDialog.querySelector('dialog')

        // Mark dialog as inert to prevent focus from moving inside
        dialog.inert = true

        dialog.addEventListener(
          'beforetoggle',
          (evt) => {
            if (evt.newState !== 'open') return

            // Fire normal events for initial value on focus if any
            for (let element of dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-initial-value-on-focus]')) {
              let value = element.getAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.removeAttribute('data-initial-value-on-focus')
              element.value = value
              element.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'))
            }

            // Then, after all events have been processed, allow focusing
            setTimeout(() => {
              dialog.inert = false
            }, 0)
          },
          { once: true },
        )

        // Now we can open the dialog
        elDialog.open = true
      }
    }
    if (customElements.get('el-dialog')) {
      onReady()
    } else {
      window.addEventListener('elements:ready', onReady)
    }
  }
</script>

            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

<script>
     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))

<script>
     window.addEventListener('load', () => window.setTimeout(() => {
        const makeLink = (asset) => {
            const link = document.createElement('link')

            Object.keys(asset).forEach((attribute) => {
                link.setAttribute(attribute, asset[attribute])
            })

            return link
        }

        const loadNext = (assets, count) => window.setTimeout(() => {
            if (count > assets.length) {
                count = assets.length

                if (count === 0) {
                    return
                }
            }

            const fragment = new DocumentFragment

            while (count > 0) {
                const link = makeLink(assets.shift())
                fragment.append(link)
                count--

                if (assets.length) {
                    link.onload = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                    link.onerror = () => loadNext(assets, 1)
                }
            }

            document.head.append(fragment)
        })

        loadNext([], 3)
    }))
